title: Treder2021 hippocampal switchboard: epoched intracranial EEG during object/scene localiser and associative recall (extra-hippocampal channels)
description: Epoched intracranial EEG from 11 epilepsy patients (22 recordings, about 9 hours of epochs at 200 Hz) recorded during an object/scene localiser task and an associative recall task. The data comprise the extra-hippocampal channels released by the authors on OSF, repackaged into BIDS-compatible BrainVision files with trial-level event information. The dataset supports investigation of the hippocampus as a switchboard between perception and memory.
methods_description: FieldTrip epoch structures (single precision, 200 Hz, time axis starting at -2 s) were rewritten as BrainVision float32 files with trials concatenated back-to-back and one New Segment marker per trial. The trialinfo fields were converted to events.tsv. Channel labels are anonymised and no coordinates or units are provided.
